UK consumer brands · Retail & beauty — British Embassy, Guadalajara's Consulate

Market entry and commercial growth for UK brands in Mexico

Challenge

UK consumer, retail and beauty brands seeking to enter and grow within the Mexican retail ecosystem.

Approach

Structured account management, commercial strategy and market-entry planning, building B2B relationships with retailers, distributors and industry stakeholders — including Hackett London, Hobbs, Phase Eight, Penhaligon's, Jo Malone and Charlotte Tilbury.

Commercial contribution

Managed a portfolio of high-value consumer brands, built commercial pipeline through strategic partnerships, and coordinated cross-functionally with government agencies and external partners.

Outcome

£52M+ in export wins across the portfolio, quadrupling 2023 export targets and exceeding commercial goals by 22% in 2024 and 8% in 2025.

Figures reflect commercial outcomes across the full brand portfolio managed, not results attributed to any single brand.
